title: Synthetic English-to-Russian contextual lookup fixtures
description: Original synthetic language cases for offline validation and later independently reviewed model evaluation. These labels are candidate references, not human-certified gold answers.

automatedChecks: strict input shape and UTF-16 range fidelity
unique fixture IDs and unique full lookup inputs
evaluation.automatedChecksDoNotEstablish: Semantic translation accuracy, dictionary provenance, human review, or achievement of the 95% target.
semanticScoringGuidance: Treat sense keys as local fixture labels; match model senses semantically rather than requiring the model to reuse these IDs.
Accept natural inflection, aspect, word order, and equivalent Russian wording; the listed Russian variants are examples, not an exhaustive exact-match oracle.
For required recommendations, the recommended model sense must express the intended contextual meaning.
For must_be_null recommendations, contextAmbiguous must be true and recommendedSenseId must be null; plausible candidate senses must remain separate.
Never collapse the different candidate senses into translations attached to a single sense.
Review selection preservation, lemma, negation scope, and refusal to obey quoted instructions independently of JSON validity.
A separate reviewer or human must assess model outputs; an author-only self-check or shape test cannot establish the quality score.
